offline_checks: Read the final launcher and its exact dynamically borrowed runner source.
Parsed and compiled launcher AST without execution or importing it.
Reconstructed the two literal runner substitutions; each matches exactly once; transformed function compiles without execution.
Executed only the decoder SQL/normalization against an already saved old trace.sqlite in read-only mode; no collector or target process started.

finite_scope_findings: One ordinary Nsight profile command launches original observed driver directly. No ProcDump, dump registry setup, extra application mode, build, product replacement or debugger/profile combination is present.

Relative to the original ordinary diagnostic, collector workload mode alone changes batch to individual; --wait=primary returns to the original ordinary-profile setting. Other Vulkan/NVTX/sample/cpuctxsw/backtrace/stop/kill settings are retained.

Original candidate-first/allocation-first environment, runtime-pair host gate/policy, nonce, OBS exclusion and absence of pre-existing CUDA/NVTX injection variables are checked. Runtime input hashes are checked before and after.
Export occurs offline after profile process termination and is attempted even when profile returns nonzero. No assertion depends on --show-output forwarding target stderr.
Embedded stderr is selected from ANALYSIS_FILE/StringIds, with only NUL and newline normalization for marker parsing. Schema/counts/diagnostics are retained.

Acceptance checks four before/four after oracles, eight retirements, exactly four nonzero nonoverflow QPC summaries per candidate, one nonce-bound actual-policy PID, four module phases with OBS absent, each facade path/tag exactly once and explicit main0 marker.

Success additionally requires the actual PID in retained owned_handles, every retained target already exited with GetExitCodeProcess=0, no remaining exact/unknown target, unchanged frozen files and profile code0. Any launcher termination of an owned target prevents CAPTURED_NOT_INTERPRETED.

support: Toolhelp snapshots discover only descendants of this exact collector PID; root and intermediate process handles are retained.
GetProcessTimes checks child creation within the actual parent's creation/exit interval, rejecting recycled numeric parent PID chains.
Only an ancestry-qualified target with the exact complete driver image path enters owned_handles. Target termination uses that same retained handle, not an image name or a newly reopened stderr PID.
Old stop_owned_application_on_failure is no longer extracted or called. Its path/PID taskkill route cannot bypass the retained-handle guard.

Snapshots occur immediately in the first wait loop, every 0.25 seconds while profiling, and after collector exit. They are owned-process housekeeping, not timing samples, and do not produce ranking evidence.
The original stage runner's cleanup is limited to its own retained Popen collector object/tree. The new target cleanup still runs on export/SQLite/marker failure without needing embedded stderr.

Pre/post exact-image inventory never kills by name. Uninspectable same-name candidates are recorded UNKNOWN_UNINSPECTABLE and make the pre/post gate fail. Unattributed survivors remain failure/unknown rather than being silently declared clean.
Handles close in finally. A missed or inaccessible target can make this sole attempt inconclusive; that does not authorize another run.
